sample_unit: foot and ankle disorders (standardized questions, one text per disorder per model)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of AI-generated patient education texts for foot and ankle disorders
links.effect: DeepSeek V3 texts were easier to read (lower FKGL, higher FRE) than ChatGPT-5 texts; the abstract reports no numeric scores and no comparison against a target patient reading level.
links.quote: DeepSeek V3 demonstrated better readability, producing simpler and more understandable content, as reflected in its lower FKGL score and higher FRE score.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the quality, reliability, and readability of texts generated by two LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) for patient education in foot and ankle disorders, evaluated offline by orthopedic specialists.
